unreported_quarters.2022Q3: Ownership change ChemoCentryx to Amgen; no figure is published. Amgen completed its acquisition of ChemoCentryx on October 20, 2022 (Amgen Form 10-K FY2022, accession 0000318154-23-000017: 'On October 20, 2022, we completed our acquisition of ChemoCentryx'); ChemoCentryx's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2022-06-30 and it filed no 10-Q for Q3 2022; Amgen's Form 10-Q for Q3 2022 (accession 0000318154-22-000055) is pre-closing and prints no TAVNEOS sales line.
unreported_quarters.2022Q4: Ownership change ChemoCentryx to Amgen; only a stub quarter is published. Amgen's FY2022 10-K prints 'TAVNEOS — U.S. (1)' 16 for 2022, consolidating ChemoCentryx only from October 20, 2022, so it is not a full quarter and is excluded; the first full Amgen quarter is 2023Q1.

notes: Series is U.S. TAVNEOS net product sales: ChemoCentryx 'Product sales, net' (2021Q4-2022Q2, all U.S. commercial sales, USD thousands) then Amgen 'TAVNEOS — U.S.' (2023Q1-2026Q2, USD millions). Amgen's 10-Qs and 10-K print the row; its earnings releases list TAVNEOS only in the pipeline text, so 2023Q4, 2024Q4 and 2025Q4 are full-year 10-K figures less the nine-month figures of the quarter's own Q3 10-Q (84, 180, 281); the four quarters of each year sum to the 10-K full year by construction. Amgen also prints 'TAVNEOS — ROW' (2023: 8; 2024: 27; 2025: 36, from 10-K) which is not included (scope U.S.). Outside the U.S. Vifor holds exclusive commercialization rights (with Kissei in Japan per the ChemoCentryx FY2021 Form 10-K); ChemoCentryx booked the Vifor agreements as collaboration and license revenue from related party, not product sales. The gap 2022Q3-2022Q4 is an ownership-change gap, so the verifier reports missing quarters for it.

ChemoCentryx: 'Product sales, net' appears first in the Q4 2021 release (965 thousand); Q1 2022 release 5,353; Q2 2022 10-Q 9,093 (no Q2 2022 earnings release was filed: the 2022-08-04 8-K was the Amgen merger agreement, items 1.01/7.01/9.01).

Amgen: grep of every release and 10-Q/10-K for 'TAVNEOS — U.S.'; Q1-Q3 read from the quarter's own 10-Q; Q4 derived (annual less nine months) because no three-month Q4 figure is printed; 2022Q4 (16) is a partial quarter from 2022-10-20 and excluded.
Rung c: Vifor (ex-U.S. rights holder, with Kissei in Japan) sells ex-U.S.; not searched for quarterly sales since the series is scoped to U.S.; ex-U.S. is not part of this series.
